component.name: Saisei
component.summary: What's playing, in the panel, with a card like macOS's Now Playing
O que está tocando, no painel, com um cartão como o Now Playing do macOS

description.p: Saisei (再生, "playback") shows what's playing in the COSMIC™ panel. Click it to open a card like Now Playing in the macOS menu bar, drawn in your COSMIC theme.

ul.li: What's playing in any MPRIS player, with its cover, and bars dancing in the theme's accent color
The card: a large cover, the title and artist, previous, play/pause and next, and a progress bar you can drag, with the time gone and the time left
Middle-click the applet to play or pause
